text:
maria: Seeing lots of 429s from customers in us-west1 starting ~09:12 UTC. Spike coincided with one tenant ramping up long-context generation. Anyone oncall?
kevin: I'm here, looking at the fleet dashboard. GPU pool us-west1-pool-3 occupancy shot to ~0.92 and queue length jumped. Saw some packet drops between zones earlier.
lina: @kevin logs show admission queue growth and backend sockets queued. Clients are getting 429s with no useful guidance, so they just retry. We're seeing retry amplification.
maria: can we add more context to 429 responses? Right now it's just 429 + generic body. SDKs need hints (backoff, severity, pool id) to avoid retry storms.
kevin: agreed. propose adding headers: Retry-After, X-Serve-Occupancy (0-1), X-Estimated-Queue-Time (ms), X-Rate-Category (soft|hard), and X-Pool-ID so clients can fallback to a different region or variant.
jon: example 429 we could return:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 12
X-Serve-Occupancy: 0.92
X-Estimated-Queue-Time: 850
X-Rate-Category: soft
X-Pool-ID: us-west1-pool-3
Content-Type: application/json

{"error":"pool_saturation","code":"POOL_SATURATION"}
```
kevin: also worth adding X-Model-Variant hint when we fallback to a cheaper variant (e.g., rdx-large -> rdx-large-quant).
lina: SDK change: stop immediate retries on soft 429s. Use exponential backoff with full jitter and honor Retry-After when present. Add a circuit-breaker after N 429s within window W to avoid tenant retry storms.
maria: can we get a short pseudocode sample for the SDK?
kevin:
```
// on receiving 429 response
cat = resp.headers['X-Rate-Category'] || 'soft'
if (cat == 'hard') {
  // fail fast and trigger application fallback
  throw new Error('rate_limited_hard')
}
// respect Retry-After if provided
let wait = resp.headers['Retry-After'] ? parseFloat(resp.headers['Retry-After']) * 1000 : base * 2**attempt
wait = jitter(wait)
await sleep(wait)
if (attemptsInWindow(tenant) > 3) openCircuit(tenant)
```
lina: ops mitigation so far: we applied a short per-tenant throttle to the noisy tenant and manually bumped autoscale for pool-3. Autoscale lagged because GPU allocation hit regional provisioning limits.
jon: longer-term suggestions: (1) warm pools / pre-allocated standby GPUs for hot regions, (2) admission tokens that clients can request before heavy jobs (serve-token), (3) cheaper model fallback routing at SDK layer when occupancy > threshold.
maria: we also need better metrics to detect retry storms: emit client_retry_multiplier and per-pool retry_rate. Include pool_id and occupancy in error logs so we can correlate.
deploy-bot: Deploy queued: feature/emit-serve-headers -> staging (CI passed).
kevin: I'll open a runtime PR to add the headers and metrics. I'll add a short notes doc for SDKs describing soft vs hard semantics.
lina: I'll open the SDK PR today to implement jittered backoff, respect Retry-After, and add circuit-breaker tests.
maria: action items: (1) runtime: add X-Serve-Occupancy + X-Estimated-Queue-Time + X-Pool-ID on 429 (kevin); (2) SDK: implement backoff/jitter + circuit-breaker + region failover (lina); (3) platform: evaluate warm-pool pre-allocation and faster provisioning for high-demand regions (jon).
kevin: starting PR now, will ping here when staging is up.
lina: will add unit/integration tests to ensure SDK honors headers and does not retry when Retry-After is present.
maria: thanks team. Follow-up check-in in #eng-runtime tomorrow 10:00 UTC to validate metrics and see if header rollout reduces client retries :thumbsup:
